comment: The quote it gave was way off for a 35 year old non-smoker.
I couldn't tell why it asked for the client's income a second time.
It kept suggesting a term plan when the client wanted whole life cover.
Took far too long to get through the health questions with the client waiting.
The voice input kept mishearing the client's name every time I tried it.
Very easy to move between pages and go back to fix an earlier answer.
This saved me so much time compared to the paper form, brilliant tool.
The branch office aircon was broken again today.
